purpose: Exhaustive Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 skill catalog coverage tracker
rule: A category is not considered complete until every indexed source record is represented and every record has been checked for duplicates, variants, CaC restrictions, unlock method, costs, and mechanics. Indexed records must not be presented as fully verified mechanics.
next_verification_work: Individual skill pages and official/game sources
Unlock source and exact drop conditions
Damage, modifiers, buffs, debuffs, hit properties and tracking
